carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, inverted card surfaces, filled blocks — the structural dark that anchors the monochrome system

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, inverted text on dark blocks, icon fills — the bright counterpoint to carbon black

warm-canvas.$description: Warm Canvas — Page background, hero backdrop, section dividers — the slightly warm gray that distinguishes this from a clinical white canvas

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Secondary surface, nav pill backgrounds, subtle panels — one step lighter than canvas for quiet layering

ash.$description: Ash — Borders, hairlines, disabled states — mid-tone neutral for structural lines

smoke.$description: Smoke — Body text secondary, meta labels, icon strokes — the muted text level for non-emphasized content

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary body text, navigation labels, and subdued headings. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Deep surface for code blocks or heavy accents — near-black alternative

mint-chip.$description: Mint Chip — Link backgrounds, tag pills, accent highlights — the signature pale green that punctuates the monochrome system

voltage-yellow.$description: Voltage Yellow — Email highlights, small accent dots, decorative bursts — the high-energy chromatic note on micro-elements

suisseintlcond.$description: Display headlines — massive uppercase condensed at extreme sizes with tight 0.9 line-height creates the editorial brutalist voice; all-caps treatment amplifies authority

suisseintl.$description: Body text, nav, subheads, buttons, cards — the workhorse neo-grotesque that handles 90% of UI; weight 450 (a non-standard intermediate) carries mid-emphasis; 40px/450 uppercase serves as secondary headlines

suisseintlmono.$description: Labels, tags, technical meta, small captions — monospace at 12px for system-level micro-copy and numbered annotations
